title: Unticking every technician hides the technician chart
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. People: at least two technicians appear in the Technician filter of the Technician Efficiency chart (they have clocked time on invoiced lines this month).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Click the Technician filter button.
  4. Untick every technician.
  5. Close the list and look at where the chart was.
  6. Tick one technician again (any one in the list).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: With no technician ticked the chart is hidden: no empty chart box or empty axes are shown in its place.
  • Steps 4 and 5: No message, toast or alert appears.
  • Step 6: As soon as one technician is ticked again the chart comes back with that technician's line.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. User Feedback Summary (section 7).
